shortDescription: India's Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses has set a price band of 143-151 rupees per share for its 50.12 billion rupees ($517.98 million) initial public offering that is set for launch on Thursday, a company filing showed on Monday.($1 = 96.7600 Indian rupees)
